Jwt.//: MUST equal JWT_SECRET in the repo-root .env. ai-service verifies the tokens this API signs, and under docker-compose it reads that .env while the API gets Jwt__Secret from the same place — so they agree. Running the API outside compose, this file wins instead, and a different value here means ai-service rejects every forwarded token with 'Invalid or expired token'. If you rotate JWT_SECRET, change it in both.

AiService.//: ai-service listens on 8000 (see apps/ai-service/Dockerfile). Under docker-compose this is overridden to http://ai-service:8000; this default is for running the API outside compose with `uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000`.

Social.//: LOCAL DEVELOPMENT ONLY — loaded when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development, never in Staging or Production. The Meta, Google and Mailjet values in this file are development credentials: production was rotated on 3 October 2026 and reads its own from App Service settings (security reviews SEC-03, R2-01). Never put a production secret here. The encryption key is a throwaway dev key.
